mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and higher risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and housing market activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS are positive, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets drive wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, correlating with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a tightening monetary policy amid rising inflation, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high residential construction regime (HOUST > 1100), strong housing market activity drives consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings benefit from the housing boom.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1100, or Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
